## About
Shirin Abplanalp is a licensed real estate agent at eXp Realty serving buyers, sellers, and relocating families across Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, and Kootenai County Idaho. She relocated to Northern Idaho herself from Bend, Oregon, giving her firsthand knowledge of the move and the lifestyle.

### Is It a Good Time to Buy a Home in Northern Idaho?
URL: https://www.realestatewithshirin.com/articles/is-it-a-good-time-to-buy-home-northern-idaho
Topic: Honest data-backed analysis of whether 2026 is a good time to buy a home in Northern Idaho — buyer leverage, mortgage rates, the rate trap argument, and who should act now vs wait
Key insight: 37.5% of Northern Idaho sales include seller concessions, median DOM is 80 days, homes sitting 90+ days sell at 94-96% of list; waiting for rates to drop often costs more than it saves due to price appreciation and loss of concessions
